thread:
Alex T: Thinking out loud — proposing a new webinar format: 'Lightning Deep Dive' (3 focused demos, tight Q&A). Goal = actionable benchmark narrative + clear next-step CTA for signups/trials. Thoughts?
Priya S: Love the format. We should anchor the narrative around 2 real workloads (chat + rerank) and show cost/latency tradeoffs with concrete numbers.
Maria G: +1. For demos I'd do: 1) hosted API quickstart (low friction), 2) dedicated capacity for predictable tail latency, 3) private/VPC mini-case (security angle).
Jake L: Run-of-show idea: Intro (5m), Benchmarks + narrative (10m), Demo 1 (12m + 6m Q&A), Demo 2 (12m + 6m Q&A), Demo 3 (12m + 6m Q&A), Panel QA (10m), CTA & close (5m). Keep total ~78m with a 5m buffer — maybe trim one demo by 5m.
Samir: We'll want a pre-recorded failover clip in case any demo fails. Also recommend a short recorded 'how we measured' clip for the benchmark methodology — hides complexity and speeds the live flow.
Tara: Speaker ops notes: hosts = Alex + Priya; Maria, Jake, and an external customer as panelists? Samir, can you host the infra mic and fallback? I'll own cueing and stage ops.
Alex T: Need abstracts for landing page. Each speaker gets a 2-paragraph blurb + 1-line TL;DR for social. Priya, can you draft 3 variants of the abstract copy (technical, business, and hybrid)?
Priya S: Yes. Drafts incoming tonight. Example tech TL;DR: "Practical levers to cut per-token costs by 30–50% while preserving tail latency for production LLM features." Business TL;DR will be lighter.
Maria G: Rehearsal schedule: engineering run (full stack, no slides) 72h before; full dress (slides + mics + recordings) 48h before; final mic/check 2h before. Also test KV cache warmups and synthetic load.
Jake L: Lead routing — we should add a 2-question intake on registration: 1) primary interest (hosted/dedicated/private), 2) timeline (pilot, POC, production). Route mapping: hosted -> inbound SDR, dedicated/private -> AE + solutions. Zapier mapping below:
```
register.form -> Zapier -> if interest == "dedicated" or "private" then create AE task else create SDR lead
fields: email, company, interest, timeline
```
Samir: Ops checklist (short): reserve 2 GPUs for rehearsal, set up canary model endpoints, pre-warm KV cache, prepare static recording fallback, ensure KMS keys for private demo. @ops — can you block GPUs on rehearsal day?
webinar-bot: Reminder created — Dry run scheduled 2026-04-10 14:00 PDT. Meeting link: https://meet.redwood.com/abc123 (calendar invites sent).
Tara: Also we need 1 slide for hosts to set expectations: audience, expected takeaways, links to benchmark repo. I'll draft and share in #marketing-assets.
Alex T: Next actions: Priya abstracts by EOD, Samir infra checklist by EOD tomorrow, Maria slides by Thu, Tara to share host slide. Sync tomorrow 10:00am for 20m. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
